% E2E canonical fixture — inline math.
% Exercises the mlist_to_hlist core: mixed Ord/Bin/Rel atom spacing
% (the 8x8 math-spacing table) and Greek \mathchardef symbols, so the glyph
% stream + inter-atom spacing byte-compare to MiKTeX within the
% tolerance (+/-0.5pt V / +/-0.1pt H).
%
% Under the bundled plain.tex format the math families (\textfont0..3),
% \mathcode for + and = (Bin / Rel), and \alpha/\beta (\mathchardef symbols)
% are all set up, so $x+y=z$ and $\alpha\beta$ render with real glyphs and
% the medmuskip-around-Bin / thickmuskip-around-Rel spacing TeX inserts.
\hsize=6.5in
\vsize=8.9in
\nopagenumbers
\noindent
The identity $x+y=z$ holds, and $\alpha\beta$ are Greek letters.
\par
\bye
